Who we are

One coach, one standard

Markaz OUJ Performance grew out of a single Taekwondo batch opened in 2014. The academy, the store and the squad all still answer to the same rule.

Sir AbdulSamad Khan opened Markaz Martial Arts Academy with eleven students and a borrowed set of pads. Twelve years later the syllabus has not been diluted once, and most of the coaches on the floor came up through it themselves.
